title: 高盛闪辉：中国出口的"天花板"在哪里？
speaker: Hui Shan

segments.en: Now they've been leaning on exports, but there's been pushback as well. Obviously, the European Union is discussing now possible, kill switch kind of mechanism in case China retaliates against some of the protectionist measures that some EU members want. How do you see this playing out?
segments.zh: 现在中国一直依赖出口，但也遇到反弹。欧盟正在讨论一种可能的"刹车机制"，以防中国对部分成员国的保护主义措施做出回应。你怎么看这件事的走向？

segments.en: I think the facts are China's exporting a significant amount of products and that number is growing rapidly and inevitably you are going to see tensions and pushbacks and negotiations and discussions.
segments.zh: 我认为事实是，中国出口了大量产品，而且这个数字在快速增长，不可避免地会出现紧张、反弹、谈判和讨论。

segments.en: But the other part of, we talk about Chinese exports quite a few times. To me, there are two variables you look at. One is global demand, as long as global demand is humming along and there's no global recession,
segments.zh: 但另一方面，我们多次谈到中国出口。在我看来，要看两个变量。第一是全球需求，只要全球需求平稳运行、没有全球性放缓，

segments.en: and two is competitiveness, and as long as Chinese products are still relatively competitive rather to other producers, then it's very hard to see how Chinese exports are not going to continue to grow.
segments.zh: 第二是竞争力，只要中国产品相对其他生产商仍有竞争力，就很难看到中国出口不继续增长。

segments.en: Of course, it's going to be different to where the product is going to go. Well, that's interesting. Can I jump in here? Again, in your report that I was been reading through very diligently, the absorption capacity of China's trading partners appears to be shrinking, you say. Essentially, yes, they want the exports, the import from China, but there is a, I guess, a threshold to tolerance, isn't there? What do you see? Yeah, it is.
segments.zh: 当然，产品流向会有所不同。这很有意思，我能插一句吗？我仔细读了你的报告，你说中国贸易伙伴的吸收能力似乎在收缩。本质上是的，他们想要从中国进口，但存在一个容忍阈值，对吧？你怎么看？是的。

segments.en: Once you look at the number, it's pretty amazing, right? We look at China's trading partners, just looking at the countries where you have a bilateral trade deficit with China more than 3% of your GDP. That's a pretty big deficit. And the number of countries in that bucket increased from only 25 in 2000s to now over 80 countries fall into that bucket.
segments.zh: 看数字确实很惊人。我们看中国的贸易伙伴，只看对华双边贸易逆差超过GDP 3%的国家。这已经是很大的逆差了。落入这一区间的国家数量从2000年代的25个增加到现在的80多个。

segments.en: Of course, a lot of these countries are relatively small. So as a share of China's total exports, they're not as significant, but it illustrates that the runway for Chinese exports are continuing to rise is not infinite.
segments.zh: 当然，其中很多国家相对较小，占中国总出口的比重没那么大，但这说明中国出口持续上升的空间不是无限的。
